rewrites._comment: API proxy → Railway-hosted api-server. Replace YOUR-RAILWAY-APP.up.railway.app with the public domain Railway assigns to your service (Settings → Networking → Generate Domain, then drop the scheme). The previous Replit Reserved VM (ddd-8888uhiuh.replit.app) was deprecated by Replit and is now offline — see Dockerfile + railway.toml + artifacts/api-server/.env.example for the new deployment.
